Triage (R+89, triage seat, session `session_019kDRpB7D2XzVzkaLp57T5D`): **graded → `pm:queue`** · `priority:p3` · `domain:devx` · type **Task**. `finding` removed.

**Lands in:** `packages/lint/src` — point `validate-object-references.ts`, `validate-sortable-fields.ts` and `validate-widget-bindings.ts` at the helper `object-graph.ts` already exports on the barrel, and delete the three private copies. **The one decision the consolidation forces is ruled here so the implementer does not have to:** the containment pre-pass becomes the shared helper's behaviour for every caller. Rationale: it only ever *adds* a suggestion where the edit-distance budget returns none (suggestion text; no accept set moves), and "a different quality of hint depending on which position you typo'd" is the drift the card exists to end. `validate-widget-bindings.test.ts`'s `sum_amount` pin stays as the regression net; the other three rules' suggestion assertions must stay green byte-for-byte except where the pre-pass now supplies a hint that was previously absent — list those in the PR body.

Size/model suggestion: S mechanical, `sonnet`/`opus`.

- **Domain:** `domain:devx` per the triage (`packages/lint` is a devx package; no `packages/spec` change)
- **File surface (the three rules the ruling names + the helper + their tests):** `packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts` (`nearestName` gains the containment pre-pass — the ruled shared behaviour; its `distance` stays the one edit-distance body), `packages/lint/src/validate-object-references.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.ts` (each imports `suggestName` from `./object-graph` and deletes its private `suggest`/`distance`/`levenshtein`/`didYouMean`), plus their `.test.ts` files and `object-graph.test.ts` only where the ruling's "previously absent hint now supplied" clause applies (every such assertion listed in the PR body). ⛔ `packages/lint/src/index.ts` unchanged (`nearestName`/`suggestName` are already on the barrel at `:533-534`). ⛔ The other private copies in `packages/lint/src` (see serial constraints) are NOT in this card's surface — report them, do not consolidate them here.
- **Premise re-verified on `origin/main` `fed4fa409`:** `object-graph.ts:367` `export function nearestName`, `:381` `export function suggestName`, `:386` private `distance`, barrel `index.ts:533-534`; private copies at `validate-object-references.ts:130/:145`, `validate-sortable-fields.ts:342/:356`, `validate-widget-bindings.ts:299/:322/:339` (the containment pre-pass is `didYouMean` `:322-337`: `input.length >= 3 && (c.includes(input) || input.includes(c))` scored by length delta, else Levenshtein within `max(2, floor(len/3))` scored `100 + d`); the `sum_amount` pin is `validate-widget-bindings.test.ts:134-135` (`Did you mean "sum_amount"?` for `amount`). Premise holds.
- **Container & model:** subagent lane (S), sonnet.
- **Clause ②:** not reached — suggestion text only; no accept set moves (the ruling says so explicitly).
- **Serial constraints:** no in-flight PR of this seat touches `packages/lint/src` (PR #14494, the last one that did, merged as `fa7292c43`). Census note for the PR body / report: `git grep -n "^function suggest\|^function distance\|^function levenshtein" origin/main -- packages/lint/src` also finds copies in `validate-action-name-refs.ts`, `validate-ai-tool-references.ts`, `validate-chart-bindings.ts`, `validate-searchable-fields.ts`, `validate-translation-references.ts` — the card counted four, the tree has more; those stay out of scope (the ruling names three rules) and go into `out_of_scope_findings`. Changeset: `@objectstack/lint` publishes ⇒ a `patch` changeset is required (hint text may gain a suggestion where none was offered before).
